settings.heading: Tell us about your dog.
settings.standfirst: Sizing, firmness, whether a bed will suit a dog with stiff joints: we answer these every day, and we'd rather you asked before you buy than after.
settings.response_time: We reply within one working day.
settings.success_text: We'll come back to you by email.
settings.answers_text: Most questions are answered here in seconds.

settings.question: Which size does my dog need?
settings.answer: Measure nose to base of tail while they're lying down, then add 15–20cm. Between two sizes? Go up.
settings.link_label: Find their size in four taps

settings.question: When will my bed arrive?
settings.answer: Order by [cutoff] on a working day and it's dispatched the same day, then [delivery_min]–[delivery_max] working days with tracking.

settings.question: Where's my order?
settings.answer: Your tracking link is in your dispatch email. If you have an account, every order and its tracking is in there too.

settings.question: What if my dog won't use it?
settings.answer: Let them sleep on it for up to [trial_nights] nights. [trial_terms]

settings.question: Can I wash it?
settings.answer: On most beds, yes: covers zip off and machine-wash at 30°C. Each product page says which applies.
